newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Rump Yugo sets '97 wheat price at one dinar/kg.
newsitem.headline: Rump Yugo sets '97 wheat price at one dinar/kg.

text.p: Rump Yugoslavia's government set Thursday the guaranteed price for the 1997 wheat crop at one dinar per kilo for first class crop, 0.9 dinars for second and 0.8 for third class crop, Beta news agency reported.

"Although the wheat price on the world market is lower, the government decided to set the guaranteed price at this level to protect and promote domestic production," Beta quoted a Federal information ministry statement as saying.

The government said it had taken all relevant factors into consideration when fixing the price such as offer and demand, production costs, changes of wheat price on the market as well as retail price movements in 1997.
Yugoslavia has sown some 800,000 hectares under wheat this year which is 217,000 ha up on last year's harvested area.
Wheat crop forecasts for 1997 are around 2.8 million tonnes, some 1.25 million more than last year according to official statistics. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 311 4305
